claims.claim: Toyota Camry engine (5x old model) direct
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an engine bay/engine assembly on the ground, but brand/model/variant is not readable.
No documentation, markings, or readable import/service labels are shown in the witness report.
Photos show engine components but do not show a running test, smoke/noise, or diagnostic results.
No audio/video of engine running is provided in the witness report.
Mileage/engine hours are not shown or readable in the witness report.
The witness report does not show evidence like untouched seals/fasteners or a clear inspection of opened components.
No written guarantee terms or proof of coverage are shown.

risks.risk: Engine make/model/variant mismatch (Camry engine may not match your intended application/compatibility).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate/stamping (engine code) and the full engine label area, plus a photo showing the exact engine code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine assembly with compatibility risk (worst-case: may not fit or may require additional parts).

risks.risk: Not actually tested/running; internal damage could exist despite appearance.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the engine starting and idling (cold start if possible) showing stable RPM and no abnormal smoke/noise, plus a scan tool readout if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: may be defective or require overhaul).

risks.risk: Hidden mechanical issues (timing chain/belt condition, head gasket, bearings, seals) not visible in the provided shots.
risks.proof: Photos of timing cover area (or timing chain/belt inspection view), and a compression test/borescope results screenshot or report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown internal condition (worst-case: timing/head gasket/bearing wear).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete components (turbo, injectors, starter, sensors, alternator/starter wiring completeness) affecting usability.
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing all major accessories and completeness: alternator, starter, injectors, fuel rail, sensors, turbo (if applicable), and the full wiring harness/ECU connections.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete (worst-case: missing parts requiring replacement).

risks.risk: Damage not captured (cracks, bent mounts, warped head, stripped fittings) could reduce value.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of critical areas: cylinder head surface, block casting, engine mounts, and any visible cracks/repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown damage (worst-case: structural or mounting issues).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamped markings (engine model/variant).
Send a short video of the engine starting and idling (showing no knock, no overheating, and stable operation).
Provide diagnostic scan results (fault codes) screenshot/photo if any scan was done.
Provide compression test results (or borescope report) and photos of timing chain/belt condition area.
Send photos confirming completeness: starter, alternator, injectors, sensors, wiring harness, and any turbo/ECU/fuel system parts (if applicable).
Provide written terms of the 'guarantee' (duration, what it covers, and return/refund conditions).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an engine assembly, but the key details needed to price confidently (exact engine variant/compatibility and proof it is tested/working) are not readable or shown. Without at least an engine-code proof and running/diagnostic evidence, pricing would be too speculative.
